summary: Fixed unreleased migrations 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, exact feet-to-metre rounding) and 0013 (no concat_ws, which SQLite 3.40.1 lacks), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 for collectors, deferred taxon seed, TS/SD basis codes). A fresh build passes all checks, and an upgraded copy of 1.6.0 matches the fresh build in schema and rows.
